meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: Xenon Core Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover and stabilize stolen xenon cores to power the syndicate's local grid.
improvisation_points: Seize the stolen cores from the enforcers at The Iron Lip.
Transport the volatile cores to Researcher Kael in the Ionization Chambers for stabilization.
Deliver the stabilized cores to Vex the Lookout at the Outcast's Perch for distribution.

quests.title: The Splicer’s Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: Create a new hybrid xenon-fungal strain to enhance syndicate soldiers.
improvisation_points: Obtain high-grade biological samples from Surgeon Vahn's lab.
Collect nerve-vine samples from Tangle-Twitch in the Gardens.
Assist Fungal-Sage Mo in brewing the final hybrid serum in the Grotto.

quests.title: Bazaar Blackmail
quests.narrative_guidance: Clean up the paper trail of a smuggling deal gone wrong in the market.
improvisation_points: Acquire the ledger from Lyla the Lush in the Blue-Mist Bazaar.
Bypass the security protocols monitored by Unit 702.
Stash the ledger in a secure crate at Scrap-Yard Plaza for Scrap-Heap Sam.

quests.title: Pit Fight Rigging
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure the high-stakes fight in the Spark-Gap Pit goes exactly as planned.
improvisation_points: Receive the betting instructions and chemicals from Gnasher.
Administer the enhancers to the fighters under the nose of Sergeant Surge.
Report the successful outcome to Mira the Hollow to collect the winnings.

quests.title: The Digital Ghost
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the Nexus network using a virus provided by a rogue AI.
improvisation_points: Receive the encrypted virus shard from Cipher-Jade.
Navigate the Mycelium Bridges with Root-Walker Rin to find the terminal.
Upload the virus into the Neural-Link Linkage and speak with The Luminous Shade.

quests.title: The Prototype Test
quests.narrative_guidance: Test a devastating new weapon powered by the heartbeat of the canyon.
improvisation_points: Pick up the prototype weapon from Blast-Master Bo at the Range.
Charge the weapon using the energy resonance from Heart-Guard Horg’s post.
Deposit the test data and the weapon in the Cryo-Vaults with Frost-Bit.

quests.title: The Deep Maw Sacrifice
quests.narrative_guidance: Clear the way for a holy ritual that requires pure xenon samples.
improvisation_points: Clear the infestation in Vein-Tunnel Alpha for Burrower Bill.
Collect purified pool water from Glow-Watcher Nia.
Present the offerings to Silence-Bringer Sol at the edge of The Deep Maw.

quests.title: The Crystallized Equation
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover a rare xenon growth that links organic and synthetic data before the storms reset the crystal's memory.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the resonant sample from Aris Thorne in the Siphon Spines.
Deliver the sample to Root-Tender Silas in Graft-Nexus for biological decryption.
Return the decrypted data crystal to Seer Lyra at the Ion-Gaze Observatory.

quests.title: The Silent Pulse
quests.narrative_guidance: Synchronize the city's pulse with the local grid to prevent a catastrophic overload in the Graft-Nexus.
improvisation_points: Obtain the frequency tuner from Pulse-Master Rez.
Calibrate the main capacitor with Volt-Runner Mika in Arclight Perch.
Take the calibrated tuner to Dr. Hekt to stabilize the Marrow Labs.

quests.title: Smuggler's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Move illicit energy cells from the high roosts of Arclight to the depths of the Static Rim.
improvisation_points: Collect the energy cells from Slick Corin in Black-Market Bay.
Bypass the air patrol by meeting Captain Vane at the Glider Launchpads.
Deliver the smuggled cells to Dockmaster Kael at Outlaw’s Anchor.

quests.title: The Marrow Graft
quests.narrative_guidance: Retrieve high-altitude marrow samples scavenged from the Void-Drop for a specialized integration experiment.
improvisation_points: Consult Vora the Carver about the specific marrow requirements.
Retrieve the rare samples from Jumper Nix at the Void-Drop.
Deliver the samples to Linker Gantz to finalize the neural bridge.

quests.title: Static Interference
quests.narrative_guidance: Neutralize a military jammer that is interfering with the Junk-Bazaar's scanners and trade routes.
improvisation_points: Receive the location of the jammer from Rat-King Rolo.
Acquire the override codes from Sergeant Flux at the Wind-Shear Battery.
Report the successful shutdown to Trader Ma at the Junk-Bazaar.

quests.title: Gantry Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Use organic acids to loosen structural bolts on a rival refinery's platform.
improvisation_points: Collect the engineering plans from Foreman Jax on the Silvered Gantry.
Acquire the biological corrosive from Drip-Watcher Mara in Graft-Nexus.
Apply the corrosive and report back to Kelso at the Refined Vein.

quests.title: The Synapse Circuit
quests.narrative_guidance: Install a neural relay in the Flicker-Light District to monitor illegal pit fights for Cipher-Jade.
improvisation_points: Take the neural relay from Warden Orl at the Living Mantel.
Hook the relay into the power grid with Neon-Fixer Pip.
Confirm the data transmission with Brawler Brigg at the Scrapper’s Gauntlet.

quests.title: The Xenon Core Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen xenon cores from unauthorized scavengers to secure the city's flux-shielding.
improvisation_points: Infiltrate the scavenger camp in the Scrapper's Gulch.
Secure the cores using specialized containment units.
Deliver the cores to the Vault for immediate stabilization.

quests.title: The Crystal Equation
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect and analyze stabilized xenon crystal samples to solve the Prime-Flux equation.
improvisation_points: Retrieve raw samples from the Accelerator Ring.
Run the data through the Synaptic Corridors processing hub.
Archive the final results in the Archive of the Blue Pulse.

quests.title: The Smuggler's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort a shipment of distilled blue-drip through the Smuggler's Rift to the Neon Bazaar.
improvisation_points: Collect the purified batch from the Distillery.
Navigate the hazards of the Smuggler's Rift.
Exchange the goods for credits at the Neon Bazaar.

quests.title: Flesh-Suture Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Eliminate rival mercenary bands that are disrupting the Tendril Bridges and Suture Maw.
improvisation_points: Track the mercenaries from the Dead-Zone Perimeter.
Defend the Tendril Bridges from a targeted sabotage attempt.
Clear the remaining hostiles from the Suture Maw.

quests.title: The Isotope Transit
quests.narrative_guidance: Safely transport unstable isotopes through a high-interference signal zone.
improvisation_points: Extract the isotopes from the Cooling Spines.
Synchronize with the Signal Jammer Spire to mask the transport.
Deliver the package to the Lead-Glass Habitats for processing.

quests.title: Mycelial Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect biomechanical samples from the Lab-Farms to improve neural linking efficiency.
improvisation_points: Harvest the mutated samples from the Mycelial Lab-Farms.
Process the samples through the Nerve-Root Junctions.
Monitor the canopy growth patterns for signs of stabilization.

quests.title: Static Whispers
quests.narrative_guidance: Decrypt a ghostly signal from the Static Shanty Town and deliver the data to the Basin.
improvisation_points: Record the static frequency in the Shanty Town.
Purify the signal in the Spore-Mist Chambers.
Apply the data to the Harvester's production schedule.
